# Relabel MONDO:0012277 → LDB3-related myofibrillar myopathy

Addresses monarch-initiative/mondo#9938 (request from the ClinGen Muscular Dystrophies and Myopathies GCEP, ORCID 0000-0002-2078-7280, https://clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40151/).

## Changes

- **Renamed** `MONDO:0012277` from `myofibrillar myopathy 4` to `LDB3-related myofibrillar myopathy`. This conforms to the standard MONDO gene-related disease naming convention `{GENE}-related {disease description}` (see CLAUDE.md guidance), replacing the OMIM numerical suffix as the GCEP requested.
- **Preserved the previous OMIM-style label** as an EXACT synonym, citing OMIM:609452:
  ```
  synonym: "myofibrillar myopathy 4" EXACT [OMIM:609452]
  ```
- **Added `term_tracker_item`** linking back to the originating issue:
  ```
  property_value: IAO:0000233 "https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo/issues/9938" xsd:anyURI
  ```

## Rationale and checks

- The term already has a logical definition that includes `has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in HGNC:15710 ! LDB3`, so the new label accurately reflects the existing axiomatization — no logical changes were needed.
- The HGNC identifier `http://identifiers.org/hgnc/15710` (LDB3) is consistent with the existing relationship; not modified.
- Existing related synonyms (`LDB3 myofibrillar myopathy (disease)`, `ZASP-related myofibrillar myopathy`, `MFM4`, `myofibrillar myopathy type 4`, etc.) are retained, so legacy lookups continue to resolve.
- Existing parent classes (`myopathy`, `autosomal dominant distal myopathy`, `qualitative or quantitative defects of protein ZASP`, `myofibrillar myopathy`) are unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Read the issue and identified the requested change (label only).
- [x] Verified the current term stanza and existing logical axioms.
- [x] Confirmed LDB3 / HGNC:15710 in the existing logical definition matches the gene named in the new label.
- [x] Renamed the term and preserved the prior label as a sourced EXACT synonym.
- [x] Added `term_tracker_item` (IAO:0000233) for the issue URL.
- [x] Used `obo-checkout.pl` / `obo-checkin.pl` rather than editing `mondo-edit.obo` directly.
- [x] Reviewed the final `git diff` — the change is limited to the renamed term.

## Not performed

- `sh run.sh make NORM` was not run because Docker is not available in this environment. The diff is small and localized; serialisation normalization can be applied as part of the usual release workflow.
